name: basque_country_real_data_two_predictor_slice
status: real canonical source data; altered K=2 design; exact conditional on six-decimal export

provenance.original_study: Abadie and Gardeazabal (2003), Economic Costs of Conflict: A Case Study of the Basque Country
provenance.transformation: all derived predictors, validation outcomes, and post summaries rounded to six decimal places with R 4.6.1
provenance.scope_note: The official Synth example uses 13 transformed predictors. This fixture fixes only mean 1960-1969 GDP per capita and mean 1964-1969 investment, so it is not a replication of the published or package estimate.

design.predictor_scaling_note: positive row scaling only reparameterizes continuous V and does not alter the lower-graph union
